_comment: Model catalog for the Lizard Studio panel. The panel fetches this file from raw.githubusercontent.com at startup, so adding a model here ships to every user without an extension release. src/panel/chat.js keeps a copy of this list as the offline fallback — update both when you edit rows, so a user with no network still sees something current. contextLimit is the usable window Claude Code's own /context reports for that model (window minus its reply reserve), not the model's raw window: the panel's ring has to read 1:1 with the terminal. Models the installed CLI doesn't know fall back to 200k there, so give them 200000 until the CLI catches up.
